text:
maria: Heads-up: we're seeing a regional perf regression in eu-central that may affect live demos for the 14:00 CET webinar. Ops investigating. Need quick ops/comm plan.

oliver: agree we should put a short statuspage banner now: 'Investigating increased latency in EU region; mitigations underway.' Keep it neutral.

sophie: if we publish the banner, let's also change the webinar landing page to 'Live session is being monitored — pre-recording available' and surface a button to watch the prerecord. avoids no-shows and sets expectations.

devops-bot: incident logged: INC-217000 (eu-central perf) assigned to infra-oncall. ETA: unknown.

maria: good. kevin, can comms own the 3-update cadence (now, +20m, +60m)? also need translated 1-line banners (de, fr, es).

kevin: yep I'll do now. draft for status page: "Investigating 5B4 Increased latency affecting text generation & embedding endpoints in EU. Our engineers are working on fixes. We will update within 20 minutes or sooner."

amy: Marketing ops note: pause all paid social + sponsored benchmark posts until cleared. Also stop any automated webinar reminders that say "live demo"; swap to "join the discussion or watch prerecord".

oliver: for registrants: short empathetic note + clear options: watch prerecord now, stay for live (if it resumes), or get recording. Draft: "We're experiencing degraded performance in EU which may impact live demos. We're monitoring and may switch to a pre-recorded demo to avoid interruptions. You'll receive an update in ~20 minutes with the final decision."

kevin: added dedicated line for enterprise customers: "Customers on Dedicated deployments are expected to have limited impact; contact your CSM if you see issues."

maria: tagging actions: kevin publish status banner + translations; sophie update landing + prerecord link; amy pause ads & update reminder copy; oliver prep registrant email. I'll check in at +20. Keep replies brief.

oliver: registrant email sent (partial): "Quick update: We may switch to a pre-recorded demo due to intermittent service latency in EU. We'll confirm in 20 minutes. Thanks for understanding."

kevin: publishing status now. translations inbound.

amy: ads paused; scheduler updated to send 'prerecord' copy instead of 'live demo'.

sophie: landing updated to show prerecord and a CTA to 'Get notified if live resumes'.

maria: thanks. If ops provides an ETA we'll decide whether to proceed live. If no resolution within 60m we cancel live and send reschedule poll.

devops-bot: update: mitigation applied (scale tuning), queue draining. Monitoring. Estimated stabilization 30-50m.

maria: noted. kevin prepare 'live will proceed' and 'switch to prerecord' templates so we can hit-send based on ops ETA.

kevin: prepping both templates now; will post here when ready.

maria: perfect. keep this thread short; if anything urgent DM me.
